book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel heki’walaŋ kwanai diniŋ kahat Lukdi youkuk

content: Poldi Mede Momooŋ yohauta tauyeeŋ muwage foloŋ looŋ Jelusalemde uguk
Nagi wooŋ muwage foloŋ kameune kutiwoi tiyemiŋa didimeŋgoŋ wooŋ Kos wosuwagumun. Uŋaniŋ dilitelegumundi heleŋ Lodes ugumundi dapmaaŋ Patala wosuwagumun.
Uŋoŋ muwage niŋ Fonisiyade we tuluguk kaŋ indi maaŋ uŋgoŋ looŋ ugumun.
Wooŋ Saipalas kapmadinik gineŋkade halune kalakapmeeŋ Siliya kwetneŋ Taiya yokwetneŋ uŋoŋ wosuwagumun. Wosuwaaŋ bomboŋ uŋgoŋ moŋgo boine tagiŋ kaŋ
indi fooŋ me nadisukilitihinit noli yabuŋa uŋoŋ Sonda kubugoŋ hatigumun. Uŋoŋ hatine Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi metam yenimbune metamdi Pol Jelusalemde mu wek niŋgiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ uuŋdok nai tuguk kaŋ muwage foloŋ lone ugumun kaŋ me hogohogok adi wapmihi-tam noŋgoŋ yanagilu ugumun. Wooŋ kiŋ foloŋ wosuwaaŋ uŋgoŋ mulelem tiŋa Bepaŋ ninadiŋa
kohokukut tiŋa hakaneeŋ yeninene adibo mawaneeŋ niniŋgiŋ kaŋ indi muwage foloŋ loyane adi maaŋ kotigoŋ yohite udaneeŋ ugiŋ.
Kaŋ indi Taiyaniŋ wooŋ Tolemes uŋgoŋ fooŋ metam kayoŋbop yabuŋa timiŋ kubugoŋ adut uŋgoŋ deikumun.
Heleune uŋaniŋ pilakumundi wooŋ Sisaliya wosuwaaŋ me uŋoŋ Mede Momooŋ yoyo tuluguk wou Filip, adi yolineŋ wooŋ itougumun. Koom Jelusalem uŋoŋ me 7 yehitubu-mintagiŋ adi’walaaniŋ me niŋ adikuyoŋ.
Adi wabiŋiye tamkuya lufolufom ala adi maaŋ polofet dabugoŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ mede yohautayagiŋ.
Ala adut uŋgoŋ yagigi-kabe hatigumun, kaŋ heleniŋ polofet niŋ wou Agabo adi Judiyaniŋ busuwaguk.

Busuwaaŋ indi yakumunneŋ buŋa Pol’walaŋ kiyegelep tiŋa ne’niŋ kohoŋ kayoŋ ibiguk. Ibiŋa yoguk, “Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi indiŋ yolak, kiyegelep i molom Jelusalem uŋoŋ Judame hekidi indigoŋ ibiŋa me fekhinit mokit heki kohohik foloŋ kameneeŋ.”
Unduŋ ninimbu nadiŋa metam uŋahi indut yali Pol Jelusalemde mu wek yoŋa nihep tugumun

kaŋ adibo niniŋguk, “Hidi maŋgoŋde makat kola welenedi Jelusalemde uuŋdok nadilat u tubugweheyeiŋ. Nu uŋoŋ wene kayone kohone hogok ibineeŋ wondok nadibedi mu tilat. Wapum Jesu doktiŋa nulukumuŋ maaŋ kedem tineeŋ.”
Unduŋ ninimbu indi kotigoŋ niŋgigine mu tugumun. Adi Wapum’walaŋ nadinadi kedem kelewek yo hogok yakumun.
Unduŋ tiŋa agaŋ uuŋdok nai tuluguk kaŋ tiulidoko tiŋa Jelusalemde ugumun.
Unene metam nadisukilitihinit Sisaliyahi adi indut noŋgoŋ ninigila wooŋ me niŋ Saipalasniŋ kayoŋbop timentimeŋ hinek tuguk wou Neson adi yolineŋ nipmegiŋ.
Pol adi Jelusalem wosuwaaŋ talitimeŋ heki dut noŋgoŋ bopnegiŋ
Jelusalem wosuwane metam nadisukilitihinit uŋoŋ itowagiŋdi kohonik kutnimgiŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa ikumun, ala heleune Pol adi Jems kawene uguk. Kaŋ kayoŋbop diniŋ talitimeŋ hogohogok noŋgoŋ bopnegiŋ.
Bopneune Poldi ne yauŋa kwanai tubune Bepaŋdi kwanaiŋiŋ gineŋ metam fekhinit mokit nemenemek tiyemguk u kahat tiyembu nadigiŋ.

Kahat tiyembu nadidapmaaŋ Bepaŋ niutumbaaŋ Pol niŋgiŋ, “Notnik Pol, i nadilaŋ be. Judame kunakunathik 1 tausen kalakapmeeŋ lolakdi Jesu’walaŋ kayoŋbop tigiŋ, iŋgoŋ Yodoko Mede u gigine tiŋa kame yakiiŋ.

Kaŋ du’walaŋ mede indiŋ buune nadiyam. Metam fekhinit mokit lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ Judame hatiiŋ adi Moses’walaŋ Yodoko Mede u mu keledok yenilaŋ, tiŋa undugoŋ wapmihi sigihik gitnem diki foloŋ fek mu titiŋdok yeniŋa Judame indi’walaŋ yayatnik be titiŋnik u wabidok yenilaŋ.
Yalaŋ mede unduŋ buune nadiyamneŋ metamdi du iŋoŋ busuwaguŋ u nadineŋ kaŋ dediŋ titiŋdok?
Moŋ doktiŋa indi ganinim uŋakoŋ keleŋ tibeŋ. Indiŋ tibeŋ, iŋoŋ me lufolufom adi Bepaŋ dut yofafaŋe tiŋa kihik filakut mu tiŋa hogok hatiiŋ.

Ala indi du adut gehitomboyoutnim kaŋ wooŋ muni hemundumunduŋe titiŋdok tuwayembeŋ kaŋ wooŋ Bepaŋdok hemiŋ tiŋa kihik kulikutneeŋ. Du unduŋ tibeŋ kaŋ metamdi du’walaŋ mede buune nadigiŋ u kaune folooŋ mokit tibek, kaŋ du Yodoko Mede uŋgoŋ kelelaŋ yo nadineŋ.

“Kaŋ metam fekhinit mokit nadisukiliti tiiŋdok adi pepa kameeŋ nanaŋe bepaŋ yalayalaŋdok hemiiŋ u mu nanaŋdok yeniŋgumun, be naŋgat, be kale kodihik foloŋ ibikilitiu kumiiŋ u mu nanaŋdok tiŋa kefifile undugoŋ mu titiŋdok u agaŋ yeniŋgumun.”

Unduŋ niŋgiŋ kaŋ heleune Pol adi mewoi u yanagila kihik filakula walandadok tali hogohogok u keleŋ tigiŋ. Tiŋa Poldi ne hogok Siloŋyotneŋ fooŋ me Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋ heki nai dediŋ hatiŋa dumuŋ heeŋ walandadok u yeniŋguk.
Judahi me nolidi Pol Siloŋyotneŋ ula hamane tukulune fakaŋ fooŋ buguk
Kadehati 7 dapmaune Judame noli Esiyahi buŋa Pol Siloŋyot maaneŋ kaŋ metam noli yeniŋgigine tubune Pol Siloŋyot maaneŋ honeeŋ ukiŋ.

Ulaŋa indiŋ kutigiŋ, “Isilaehi metam, buŋa nihitubu-lodayaneŋ. Me kwetkwet yauŋa Isilaehi indi’walaŋ titiŋnik mu keledok yenilak eŋ Moses’walaŋ Yodoko Mede maaŋ mu keledok yenilak, tiŋa undugoŋ Siloŋyot yendok mede kadakaniŋ nilak, me iŋakoŋ. Tiŋa undugoŋ kamiŋ me fekhinit mokit yanagila buŋa Siloŋyot maaneŋ fooŋ Siloŋyot Uŋgoniŋ u tubukadaka tilak.”
(Pol adi me Efesoniŋ Tolofimo nagi buguk kagiŋ doktiŋa Siloŋyotneŋ noŋgoŋ nobu fodemek yo unduŋ kutigiŋ.)
Togiyonda wapumdi yokwet u tuwot tubune metam noŋgoŋ kiyaneeŋ wooŋ Pol honeeŋ hamane tukulu fakaŋ fobuguk, kaŋ Siloŋyot taliyeme pilap hinek tehegiŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa metam adi Pol agaŋ ulukumune tulu Loma mikme’walaŋ talitimeŋdok mede indiŋ kamemiŋgiŋ, “Jelusalem me hogohogok mik tine tiiŋ.”
Unduŋ nimbu uŋaniŋgoŋ mikme yanagila talitimeŋhik maaŋ yeniŋa noŋgoŋ kiyaneeŋ metam bop hakiŋneŋ fosuwagiŋ. Kaŋ metamdi yabuŋa Pol ukiŋ wabiŋa hogok yakiŋ.
Wabiŋa yalune mikme’walaŋ talitimeŋdi wooŋ Pol honeeŋ yenimbune tawa fafaŋeniŋ (sen) lufomdi youkilitigiŋ. Youkilitigiŋ kaŋ indiŋ yeninadiguk, “Me i neeŋ? Adi maŋgoŋ tiŋak kaŋ ukiŋ?”

Unduŋ yeninadiguk kaŋ metam noliyeŋ nemek niŋ kutibu, noliyeŋ nemek niŋ kutigiŋ. Unduŋ kutiŋa toŋgiyonda wapum hinek tigiŋ kaŋ maŋgoŋde tiŋa ukiŋ u mebi hinek mu nadiŋa mikmeŋiye yenimbune Pol nagila mikme heki’walaŋ yohineŋ logiŋ.
Metam hogohogok gu mik titiŋdok namandap hogok diweeŋ ilaugiŋ doktiŋa mikme hekidi talolok foloŋ wosuwaaŋ tubupilali beem tiŋa logiŋ.
Tubu metam adi mindaŋ yehikeleeŋ kakaliŋa indiŋ kutigiŋ, “Ulukumuŋ tineŋ.”
Poldi Isilaehi nehi’walaŋ mede gineŋ hinek mede yenihautaguk
Unduŋ tiŋa yot maaneŋ fofoŋdok tubudulalu Poldi me wapum u indiŋ ninadiguk, “Kedem be mede neeŋ yobit?” Unduŋ ninadiguk kaŋ me wapumdibo Pol indiŋ ninadiguk, “Du Gilik mede uŋgoŋ be nadilaŋ?
Koom Isipniŋ me niŋ gapman mik timiŋa me 4 tausen yanagila wooŋ kwet fiileŋ itougiŋ u du kube?”
Unduŋ niŋguk kaŋ Poldibo yoguk, “Nu adi Judame, Silisiya maaneŋ Tasus uŋoŋ mintagut, tiŋa undugoŋ nu yokwet wapum wougigitnit gineŋ itoulat. Ale kedembe metam mede yenimbit?”
Unduŋ nimbune me wapumdi fiit nadimimbune talolok foloŋ uŋgoŋ yali kabup yayatdok kohowobu tubune metam mede wabiŋa kabup yadapmaune Pol adi Isilaehi nehi’walaŋ mede gineŋ hinek mede yoguk.
